title: AxiomDiagnosticResponse
description: A 200 response from POST /api/diagnose. Errors use error.schema.json.

composite_archetype.description: Two to four words describing how this configuration resolves trade-offs.

executive_summary.description: Two to three sentences on trade-offs under pressure.

rigidity_index.description: Judged on the specificity of the fracture points, not on the height of the conviction values.

blind_spots.description: Each item names one friction between a stated stance and a stated fracture point.

stress_response_prediction.description: Likely first reaction when the primary system fails without warning.
